verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own REST API exposes "much of the data in the system" in JSON. Its docs say it can be used to "get data out to integrate with other systems", and item listings support pagination, so a user can pull error data out programmatically. However, coverage is explicitly "much" rather than all, and there is no documented bulk export or account-exit flow. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-account data export (bulk dump of items, occurrences, deploys, people, settings), confirmation that all data types are exportable, documented account/data deletion on leaving, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
